This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Kantabanji P.S. Case No. 377 of 2023 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No. 98 of 2023, pending in the file of learned Special Judge (POCSO), Balangir, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.366/376(2)
(n)/376(3)/506 of IPC and Sec.6 of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of kidnapping the victim and committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon her.

3. Heard, Mr. Devashis Panda, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. P. Satpathy, learned Addl.
Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
None appears for the victim despite being duly informed as apprised by the learned State counsel.
4. It is not disputed that the victim has already been examined in this case and thereby, there is little apprehension of tampering of evidence of material witness like victim.

In such view of the matter and after having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis-- vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and regard being had to the pre-trial detention of the petitioner in custody since 02.12.2023 and taking into account the mandate of Sec.35(2) of the POCSO Act, this Court without expressing any view on merits, admits the petitioner to bail.

Hence, the bail application of the Petitioner stands allowed and the Petitioner is allowed to go on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-five Thousand) only with one solvent surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin of the case on such terms and conditions as deem fit and proper by it with following conditions:-
(i) the petitioner shall not contact the victim or visit her house or place of residence till disposal of the case,
(ii) the petitioner shall not threaten the informant or shall not coerce, induce or influence any of the witnesses acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts before the learned trial Court.
6. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
